page.overview:
Who is Litter Bot 18?

Litter Bot #18, known as Obot Unit 18 in the Japanese version, is a character in Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL World Duel Carnival.

をしたおロボット。のオボットにべてかなりで、によくをしてサボっている。いわくシステムメンテナンスだったり、エネモードだったり、だったりとはあるらしいが、らかにいているのがい。その、にしかけられてもぐにはのことだとけず、よくとえられてメンテナンススタッフにされていく。のでは、オボット１８がいているところをれたら、そのはラッキーにまれるとのまでまれている。

One of the cleaning robots possessing artificial intelligence that is usually referred to as an Obot.Considerably more carefree than most other Obots, and prone to stopping in the middle of any given task to slack off.It always claims to have reasons for doing so, such as undergoing system maintenance, or operating under energy saving mode, or taking a scheduled break - ultimately, it clearly works less than it rightfully should.As most people do not recognize this unit immediatly, they think its behavior is due to a malfunction rather than its own personality, which leads it to be picked up for repairs by the maintenance staff repeatedly.According to an urban legend, if you see Obot Unit 18 working, it's your lucky day.
